messages:
tori: kicking off eu-central canary for embed-service v2.20 at 25% traffic. doing short preflight and will watch SLO panels.

deploy-bot: Automated: release=v2.20 stage=canary region=eu-central traffic=25% commit=8c7d4f preflight=[metrics,traces,kvcache,autoscaler]

alex: grabbing the SLO dashboard link https://dash.redwood.ai/slo/embed-service?region=eu-central&window=10m

maya: p95 for embed-route creeping up from ~100ms to ~360ms in the last 4m, and a small uptick in 5xx sampling

jamal: checking node telemetry: a subset of canary pods shows CPU saturation and eviction counts climbing. autoscaler not yet reacting.

srebot: WARNING: slo.embed-route.p95 crossed alert threshold (rule=slo-embed-95). routing alert into thread.

ops-runbook: Quick runbook note: when p95 > 300ms AND autoscaler not scaling -> consider holding and pinning canary, trigger warm-cache job. https://runbooks.redwood.ai/deploys/quick-hold

 tori: hold the ramp at 25%. do a canary-only pin to previous stable (v2.19) while we triage. who can run the pin?

maya: applying pin now: ./deployctl pin --service embed-service --version v2.19 --scope canary

deploy-bot: Pin accepted: service=embed-service pin=v2.19 scope=canary propagating (~18s)

jamal: correlating traces -> long-context requests hit quantize-v2 path causing additional CPU and KV-cache churn; kvcache hitrate dropped ~15pts at the same time

maya: pin live. muting slo-embed-95 alerts for 15m to avoid noisy pages while we stabilize. launching warmpool prefetch to refill prefix cache.

alex: monitoring. if p95 and 5xx normalize in 10m we can keep paused and open a follow-up ticket; if not, we roll back globally. add a short note to the release log.

 tori: adding release note: "Canary pause: transient embed-route latency observed during canary v2.20. Pinned canary shards to v2.19 while we investigate quantize-v2 CPU/kv-cache interaction."

jamal: observing p95 falling toward baseline (~120ms) and 5xx dropping. looks like cache regen + pin helped. will post follow-up RCA ticket link once created.

deploy-bot: Status: canary held@25%, pinned=v2.19, alerts muted. will update thread on new signals.
